name: cline
installHint: npm install -g @cline/cli (preview) or use the VS Code extension https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=saoudrizwan.claude-dev

quirks.notes: Cline started as a VS Code extension; the standalone CLI is in preview. Reads .clinerules for project conventions. Most stable when invoked through VS Code, but the headless CLI path is wired here for parity.
